description.zh: 一个图标在两种状态间平滑变形，而不是替换—— 最经典是汉堡三横变关闭叉。 用同一组线条的旋转、位移与透明度组合完成， 传达"同一个控件换了状态"。
description.en: One icon smoothly morphs between two states instead of being swapped — classically the hamburger turning into a close X. Built from the same strokes rotating, translating and fading, it says "same control, new state".

use_when.zh: 汉堡菜单 ↔ 关闭、播放 ↔ 暂停等成对状态
同一位置的切换型图标按钮
use_when.en: Toggle-type icon buttons in a fixed spot

use_when.zh: 需要强调"状态变了"而空间不变
use_when.en: Emphasising a state change without moving layout

avoid_when.zh: 两个语义无关的图标（变形反而误导）
变形前后形状差异过大（中间帧生硬）
avoid_when.en: Shapes too different — the in-between looks broken

avoid_when.zh: 图标极小（小于 16px 变形细节看不清）
avoid_when.en: Tiny icons under 16px — the morph is illegible

note.zh: 中线上移淡出、上下线旋转交叉
note.en: Middle line fades out, outer lines rotate to cross

note.zh: 整体旋转 45°，最简单的变形
note.en: A 45° rotation of the whole icon — the easiest morph

note.zh: 三角与双竖条互相变形
note.en: Triangle and double bars morph into each other

notes.zh: 用三条 span（或 SVG line）加 transition transform 300ms。 汉堡变叉：上线 translateY(6px) rotate(45°)，下线 translateY(-6px) rotate(-45°)， 中线 opacity 0。 aria-label 必须随状态切换； 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 改为直接切换图形。
notes.en: Three spans (or SVG lines) with transition transform 300ms. Hamburger to X — top line translateY(6px) rotate(45°), bottom translateY(-6px) rotate(-45°), middle opacity 0. The aria-label must switch with the state; respect prefers-reduced-motion by swapping the glyph directly.

basic.zh: 给导航按钮添加汉堡变叉的图标变形动画。
basic.en: Add a hamburger-to-X morph to the nav toggle button.

design.zh: 菜单开合时汉堡三横在 300ms 内变形为关闭叉：上下线旋转交叉、中线淡出；图标占位不变，aria-label 同步切换。
design.en: On menu toggle, the three bars morph into a close X within 300ms — outer lines rotate to cross, the middle fades out; the icon footprint never moves and the aria-label switches in sync.

implementation.zh: 三条绝对定位 span，open 状态：上线 translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)，下线 translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg)，中线 opacity 0；transition transform+opacity 300ms。按钮加 aria-label={open ? 关闭 : 菜单}。reduced-motion 关闭过渡。
implementation.en: Three absolutely positioned spans; when open — top translateY(6px) rotate(45deg), bottom translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg), middle opacity 0; transition transform+opacity 300ms. Set aria-label={open ? Close : Menu}. Disable the transition under reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目导航按钮实现汉堡变叉图标变形。

先检查现有图标体系（SVG 或 iconfont），选择可行的实现层。
要求：
- 同一组线条的 rotate/translate/opacity 过渡，300ms
- aria-label 随状态切换，键盘可触发
- 图标占位尺寸不变，无布局位移
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a hamburger-to-X morph for the project's nav toggle.

Check the existing icon system (SVG or iconfont) first and pick a feasible layer.
Requirements:
- rotate/translate/opacity transitions on the same strokes, 300ms
- aria-label switches with state; keyboard operable
- Fixed icon footprint, no layout shift
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
